acceptanceCriteria: A documented heuristic recognises tests that create their own fixture data and session, with a positive and a false-positive-guard fixture
TSA-V0 records the heuristic and its limits
body: GitHub #1123 asked ISOLATED-IN-SERIAL to cover tests that carry an isolation annotation OR create their own fixture data and session. PR #1125 recognises only explicit @isolated tags and isolated annotations (hasIsolatedTag / isolated in internal/testsource/validity.go). Expected: a bounded, documented heuristic for own-seed/own-session tests. Actual: annotation-only, so unannotated isolated tests in serial suites are missed.
title: ISOLATED-IN-SERIAL: treat tests that create their own fixture data and session as isolated (residual of PR #1125)
